left.raw_text: Must have pathologically confirmed invasive adenocarcinoma
Patients must have undergone segmental mastectomy
Patients must not have received prior radiation therapy to the breast.
Patients must not have active local-regional disease prior to registration.
Patients must not be pregnant because of the potential for fetal harm as a result of radiation treatment.
Women of child-bearing age will be given a serum pregnancy test prior to study entry to ensure they are not pregnant.

right.raw_text: They will also be counseled on the importance of avoiding pregnancy and hormonal contraception while undergoing radiation therapy.
